name: Same-version release run adoption after an interrupted cut
trigger: Run the real release-loop graph runner until its simulated gate fails, then issue the same stable version again through the production unattended release coordinator.
observe: production coordinator resumes the original run ID from the failed gate
resumeInputPatch restores the missing gateImagePin before the gate runs
the simulated gate passes and the real graph reaches done
the existing release branch is adopted and the graph-run ledger remains one entry
expected: The real graph runner fails at gate on its first pass and completes at gate on the second request, keeping one run ID and one ledger row.
